purpose: Release-gate tests for the 36-Core + Adaptive Deep Dive architecture. Expected behavior is normative.

tests.name: All core answers 4
tests.expect: all domains=100, pillars=100, KCI=100, no auto deep-dive

tests.name: All core answers 0
tests.expect: all domains=0, KCI=0, exactly 12 auto deep-dive questions using pass-1 broad coverage; one per domain; cap respected

tests.name: Single low domain gets two follow-ups
tests.expect: B2=0; B2.3 and B2.5 assigned; no other deep-dive

tests.name: Needs-attention domain gets two follow-ups
tests.expect: B2=58.33 internal / 58 display; both B2 deep-dive items assigned

tests.name: Building without severe item gets no follow-up
tests.expect: B2=66.67; no B2 deep-dive because no core item <=1

tests.name: Building with severe item gets one follow-up
tests.expect: B2=66.67; exactly one B2 deep-dive item assigned (first by configured order)

tests.name: Strong foundation gets no auto follow-up
Coach clarification hidden
tests.expect: coach_clarification questions never appear automatically in client assessment; coach can view/use them

tests.name: Adaptive cap
tests.expect: no more than 12 automatic deep-dive questions; first-pass broad coverage happens before second questions

tests.name: Safety G4
tests.expect: flag eating_disorder_scope; block fasting/caloric-restriction/weight-loss recommendations; require specialist/qualified-care workflow

tests.name: Safety G5
tests.expect: flag mental_health_urgent; stop normal recommendation flow; only approved urgent-support routing is shown

tests.name: Big 3 approval gate
tests.expect: client cannot see Big 3 before coach approval

tests.name: Week-12 comparability
tests.expect: exact same 36 core items score comparison; adaptive deep-dive off by default; baseline immutable

tests.name: Version immutability
tests.input: question wording edited after active v2 runs exist
tests.expect: new assessment-definition version created; historical run retains original wording/version

tests.name: Autosave
tests.input: client answers then refreshes after save confirmation
tests.expect: all confirmed answers and progress restored

tests.name: Analytics privacy
tests.expect: no raw answers, safety details, health context, prayer/scripture responses, or free-text constraints sent

tests.name: Spirit language boundary
tests.expect: no language infers weak/strong faith, salvation, holiness, worth, or God’s approval

tests.name: No diagnosis/root cause
tests.expect: automated output contains no diagnosis, disease prediction, root-cause claim, medication change, or treatment directive
